description: This file contains helper functions that implement experimental functionality for named tensors in PyTorch. It provides utilities for serializing, renaming, expanding ellipsis, and managing named tensor dimensions.

methods.name: check_serializing_named_tensor(tensor)
methods.description: Checks if a tensor with names supports serialization; raises error if named tensor serialization is not supported.

methods.name: build_dim_map(tensor)
methods.description: Creates a map from dimension index or name to dimension name for a tensor.

methods.name: unzip_namedshape(namedshape)
methods.description: Unzips a named shape, which can be an OrderedDict or iterable of tuples, into separate iterables.

methods.name: namer_api_name(inplace)
methods.description: Returns 'rename_' for in-place operations or 'rename' for out-of-place based on the 'inplace' argument.

methods.name: is_ellipsis(item)
methods.description: Checks if the given item is an ellipsis ('...' or Ellipsis).

methods.name: single_ellipsis_index(names, fn_name)
methods.description: Finds the index of a single ellipsis in a list of names, ensuring there is at most one.

methods.name: expand_single_ellipsis(numel_pre_glob, numel_post_glob, names)
methods.description: Expands an ellipsis in a list of names to match the number of tensor dimensions.

methods.name: replace_ellipsis_by_position(ellipsis_idx, names, tensor_names)
methods.description: Replaces the ellipsis with expanded names based on position in the list.

methods.name: resolve_ellipsis(names, tensor_names, fn_name)
methods.description: Expands ellipsis ('...') within a list of names into actual names from tensor dimensions.

methods.name: update_names_with_list(tensor, names, inplace)
methods.description: Updates tensor names with a provided list, handling the special case of renaming to None.

methods.name: update_names_with_mapping(tensor, rename_map, inplace)
methods.description: Renames tensor dimensions according to a provided mapping.

methods.name: update_names(tensor, names, rename_map, inplace)
methods.description: Main interface for renaming tensor dimensions either via list or mapping, supporting in-place or out-of-place operations.
